_comment: Dependency high/critical exceptions reviewed 2026-10-20. Only currently reported, triaged exceptions remain. scripts/auditGate.mjs accepts only each named high/critical advisory ID, never future advisories. reviewBy is a manual re-triage deadline, not an automatically enforced expiry; evidence is linked per entry. Remove an entry once patched. Moderate findings are reported, not silently counted as resolved.

allow.reason: High severity is inherited only through its dev-only chokidar -> braces dependency; all previously vulnerable brace-expansion copies were patched to compatible 1.1.21/2.1.7/5.0.12. firebase-tools is a deployment CLI devDependency, never a production import or shipped runtime dependency. Latest published 15.34.0 still requires chokidar ^3.6.0, so a routine parent upgrade does not resolve the remaining high advisory. No own high/critical advisory is accepted. Re-review by reviewBy.

GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv affects RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification; npm latest remains 1.4.0 with no fixed release on 2026-10-20. The only production importer is src/server/lib/androidKeystore.ts, which creates/self-signs certificates and serializes PKCS#12; RSA key generation uses native Node crypto. No production code uses forge signature verification. tests/nodeForgeNeverVerifies.test.ts guards that reachability assumption; tests/androidKeystore.test.ts validates the actual generated keystore. Re-review by the recorded reviewBy date or immediately if a fixed release/importer is added.

GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm covers <=3.0.3; npm latest is still 3.0.3 on 2026-10-20. The installed chain is firebase-tools@15.28.2 -> chokidar@3.6.0 -> braces@3.0.3, only in dev/deploy CLI tooling. Published firebase-tools@15.34.0 still declares chokidar ^3.6.0. No src/scripts/server.ts production importer uses braces/chokidar/firebase-tools, and node_modules/firebase-tools is absent from the pruned production dependency graph. Do not override chokidar to a breaking major; update the parent when it supports a patched dependency. Re-review by reviewBy.

High severity is inherited only through the reviewed braces GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm. Installed solely beneath devDependency firebase-tools; not imported by production application code or retained by npm prune --omit=dev. Current upstream parent still requires chokidar ^3.6.0. No own high/critical advisory is accepted by this entry. See the braces evidence and reviewBy.
